notes.title: Version 1.34.3 + 1.34.4 - New Item Mall Previews & Customizations
notes.content:
Changelog - Version 1.33.3 + 1.34.4 - English

- Fixed: The item preview in the Item Mall showed female clothing on male characters of the Mage class.
- Fixed: Positioning of the hair in male Archer Wood Elves.
- Added: Preview of some categories of items in the Item Mall.
- Added: New haircuts for all races and genders.
- Added: New Horns for Uthgars and new skins for Lamai characters.
- Added: Previsualization in the Item Mall of the items Hair Cut, Change Horns and Change Skin.

We hope you enjoy these new additions to the game! :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459215/45d0c360df1303b8f44df597c4388c9f7489c827.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 1.33.2
notes.content:
- Fixed: Trainers of other classes or subclasses having the available option to Reset Powers and/or Train, causing confusions.
- Fixed: Description of Warmaster Coins booster scrolls.
- Fixed: Description of Race Change scroll.
- Fixed: Being able to cast an instant spell while jumping, causing the combat status to get visually broken.
- Fixed: Mercenary Staff size was too big.
- Fixed: Size of the Mercenary Mage Hat for the female characters.
- Fixed: Protection modifier being shown among the item modifiers when it should only appear as a bonus value next to the base armor value (+X).
- Fixed: Terrain in two locations of the Battlezone Team Deathmatch map in which players could gain an unfair advantage.
- Fixed: One cause of crashes in the client positioning code.
- Fixed: In-Game Rankings interface showing rows from previously selected ranking category.
- Modified: In-Game Rankings interface now has the time range "All" as default instead of "Week".
- Added: Mercenary Spear, Two Handed Spear, Mace, Two Handed Mace, Off Hand Mace, Sword, Two Handed Sword, Off Hand Sword, Axe, Two Handed Axe, Off Hand Axe.

notes.title: The Halloween Event is live - Face the Zombie King!
notes.content:
[h3][b]We would like, if we may, to take you on a strange journey.[/b][/h3]

[b]The Zombie King is wandering the lands[/b] and we have to stop him! [b]Charge your gem by defeating enemies from other realms and face the Zombie King when he appears in the War Zone[/b]. It will not be an easy battle and he might not even be the worst foe you will have to face…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459215/96c77356d82e6d4838d621d5c9805fe87e06acd2.png[/img]

Facing horrors like this one shall of course not be unrewarded. We can purify the darkness brought upon the land and use it to[b] craft a special robe worthy of a nightmare slayer![/b] Collect proof of your deeds against the undead army without losing your courage and sanity and it shall be yours! If you aren’t sure if you’re well equipped for the fight we will have [b]special weapons available in the store[/b] to fight back the darkness.

Additionally if you are returning, enjoy our[b] new equipment enhancing system, community events such as treasure hunts[/b] organized by us, and our [b]newly established Streamer Program[/b] and [b]soon to come changes to the Battlezones![/b]

Slay, win and show them who they should really be afraid of!

Enjoy the Event and make sure to [b]grab your loot from October 28th - November 1st, champions![/b]

notes.title: Ximerin promo and bugfixing update!
notes.content:
Ximerin promo and bugfixing update!

The update with the bugfixing changes is ready. Also, 25% bonus for all your Ximerin purchases!

The Ximerin promo will end next Wednesday, 12th at 12:00PM GMT.

Changelog:

- [b]Added[/b]: Invasions balance level shown in the map with details about the current level, if any.
- [b]Added[/b]: Alternative combat music. Can be activated in the Options interface. This is to test the music track and get feedback about it.
- [b]Added[/b]: New Warzone Boss. Aurus Nightshade is a bandit, son of pirates that were forced out of the sea and is always followed by his thugs. He is taking care of a treasure chest and you must kill him to open it.
[list]
[*] It appears randomly every 2 to 6 hours in the Warzone.
[*] Rewards include Magnanites, Lucky Boxes and Aurus Corsair Saber.
[/list]

- [b]Added[/b]: Other available subclasses to be selected in the Dungeons tab in the Community interface. These will be shown to the dungeon party creator.
- [b]Added[/b]: Premium Dungeon match maker. Access the Dragon Dungeon from wherever you are. Still needs tickets, availability (gems and invasions) and can be used once every 24 hours.
- [b]Modified[/b]: Stash Carrier model. It is now a troll creature with a bag in its back.
- [b]Modified[/b]: Old unique clothing items can now be stashed both in character and account stashes.
- [b]Modified[/b]: Old unique clothing items can now be stashed both in character and account stashes.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: German text for Tenax dungeon in Dungeons tab.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Stash Carrier not going away when the stash use is finished.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Getting stuck between two rocks at:
[list]
[*] Menirah's Surroundings.
[*] Withering Heights.
[/list]

- [b]Fixed[/b]: Players being lured to a location that could make them drown under a bridge between Aggersborg and Herbred and near it as well.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Teleport Scroll cannot be used if the player was recently under combat.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Mindsquasher was not cancelling the spells in the correct order in some specific cases.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Angel wings showing different colors.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Two handed execution spear scale was incorrect.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Reward armour of the Elite Guard Training quest in Ignis had visual errors.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: Text in Squid Island's Ignis quest was not set for one of the objectives.
- [b]Fixed[/b]: NPC Nienna in Korsum wearing warrior armour as an archer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459215/b9b36aa0f6f1b14da2c86a377b834c39a2391b7e.png[/img]

notes.title: 13th Anniversary
notes.content:
Today is Regnum's 13th anniversary! 

To celebrate it, we will open Squid Island to all levels. This will be an introduction to a place that will become very important for the future of the game, we hope you enjoy it!

Now you can start the quest! A total of 6 and you may find them on the following NPCs:
- In Alsius, provided by Ursor, Erikin, Daulia and Galmor
- In Ignis, by Saniur, Mirash, Oriah and Falamar
- In Syrtis, by Mauro, Ilens, Halma Ex and Elismon

Changelog:
- Added: Zeppelin to access Squid Island from the War Zone.
- Modified: Size of the Zeppelin icon in the map is now smaller.
- Modified: War Zone treasures have been greatly enhanced.
- Modified: "Worn" and "Defective" item qualities have been removed. Items with any of these qualities are now "Common".
- Fixed: Name of the reward to be chosen in certain quests was not being shown.
- Modified: Access to Squid Island to all levels.
- Added: Xymerald poisoning in Squid Island. A player can stay in the island for 1 hour until the poisoning starts to drain health until death. For each second in the island, it takes two to recover. After being for an hour in the island, you must wait 2 hours outside of it until effects are reverted and you're able to go back.
- Added: Quest objective "Fight with an enemy".
- Added: Boss in Squid Island (for now, just guarding the area).
- Added: Ability for creatures to drain health in an area.
- Added: Performance enhancements to the server.

And there's more: all purchases from today at 12 AM GMT and on have a 30% Ximerin bonus! Enjoy!

If you want to see the new clothes: https://www.facebook.com/pg/ChampionsOfRegnum/photos/?tab=album&album_id=10156944021301109

Enjoy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4459215/2c7143d62e61eb09056234d7f0e45013f0207792.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Important Changes Available Now!
notes.content:
During the last months we've gone through an amazing development stage that resulted in a huge list of positive changes which are pointing into a better game experience. This couldn't have happened without the help from our community. Feedback and volunteering are a key factor for a game to get to its maximum potential. So, thank you and let's keep up the good work!

[h1]Let's see some highlights of what changed in the last months.[/h1]
[list]
[*]Team Deathmatch Battlezone fully renewed. Better map and interface: enhanced experience! Did someone say mini-bosses?
[*]Improved attack from Wall Walks in all fortifications. The best defense is a good offense.
[*]Statistical Random Number generation. Improved chance calculation, meaning a more accurate gameplay.
[*]Experience for killing enemies. Battles are fun. And levelling in them, a lot more!
[*]Faster access to the War Zone. Vigilant Spirit puts the best combat only a few steps away.
[*]Creatures re-positioned all over the world. Find a better challenge, always.
[*]New Warmaster jewellery. Obtainable with coins rewarded by dead enemy players. That's more like it!
[*]Faster Main Quest line. Choice to go quicker without missing out what's important of your Realm.
[*]Companions. May the ones who walk beside you elevate what's best in you.
[/list]

And that's just a tiny list. Check out our [url=https://www.championsofregnum.com/changelog]Change Log[/url] for more details. See you in-game!
